part: final-c days 6-9 (Kyoto Sun Jan 24, Suzuka + Liberty Walk Mon Jan 25, KIX -> CTS + drive to Niseko Tue Jan 26, first ski day Wed Jan 27)

issues.problem: On weekday open days in late January the kart runs only a short midday window (Fri Jan 23 and Mon Jan 26, 2026: 12:25-13:05, 80 karts), not from 10:00, so the 'first slot, then the 13:00 bus' plan does not work if 2027 is the same.
issues.evidence: https://www.suzukacircuit.jp/park/attraction/challenger/ (calendar: Google calendar 'サーキットチャレンジャー営業スケジュール', Jan 2026 entries); schedule for the next month is published on the 1st at 0:00
issues.fix: On Dec 1, 2026 read the real Jan 25 kart times before you book. Plan for a kart about 12:25-13:05, then take the 15:10 bus (or a taxi, about 20 min) to Shiroko; Liberty Walk is still possible at about 18:00 because it is open until 21:00.

issues.problem: There is no 13:00 bus; on weekdays the buses from the circuit to Shiroko leave only at 13:10, 15:10, 17:00 and 17:45, and to the circuit at 09:40, 10:20, 12:20, 14:20, 16:20.
issues.evidence: Mie Kotsu GTFS open data (Chusei office, valid Sep 8-Dec 28, 2026): https://bus-vision.jp/gtfs_v2/chusei/gtfsFeed ; https://www.suzukacircuit.jp/access_s/train_bus/
issues.fix: Use the 08:00 Kintetsu Hinotori/Urban Liner from Osaka-Namba (Shiroko 09:36-10:08, about 1 h 40, ¥3,510 one way, no change needed on the 08:30 Urban Liner) and the 10:20 bus; back on the 15:10 bus. Check the winter timetable again in January.

issues.item: Liberty Walk JDM PARK / LB DRIVE-IN hours
issues.problem: The place info says 'open 365 days', but the official site says closed on Thursdays (11:00-21:00); Monday is open, so the day still works.
issues.fix: Change the info to '11:00-21:00, closed Thursdays'.

issues.item: Aoki's dawn train to Fushimi Inari
issues.problem: On Sunday morning the trains from Nagahoribashi leave at 06:06 (arrive 07:05) and then 06:39 (arrive 07:49), so leaving at 06:30 gives 07:50, not 07:30.
issues.evidence: Jorudan, Sunday search Nagahoribashi -> Fushimi-Inari: https://www.jorudan.co.jp/norikae/
issues.fix: Aoki leaves the hotel at 05:55 for the 06:06 train, or accepts 07:50 and turns back earlier than Yotsutsuji.

issues.problem: The direct bus 205 takes about 53 min (plan: 40 min) and is crowded on Sundays, so with the late start Aoki reaches Kyoto Station at about 11:30 or later.
issues.evidence: Jorudan Kinkakuji-michi -> Kyoto: direct bus 53 min, via Kitaoji bus terminal + Karasuma Line 26-31 min
issues.fix: Aoki takes bus 204/205 to Kitaoji Bus Terminal and the Karasuma subway to Kyoto (about 30 min), or you meet at Kitayama (Kyoto Concert Hall) and do Kyoto Station at the end of the Kyoto part.

issues.problem: The morning Rapi:t leaves Namba at 07:00 (arrives KIX 07:34), not 07:05, and costs ¥1,670 (the day cost says ¥1,490).
issues.evidence: Jorudan Nankai-Namba -> Kansai Airport, weekday 06:55 search (timetable Oct 2026)
issues.fix: Change the stop to 07:00 and the cost to ¥1,670; the 07:10 airport express (¥970, arrives 07:56) is a cheap backup.

issues.item: Ski rental at Rhythm Hirafu, then drive to Annupuri at dusk
issues.problem: Car at 13:20 + 2 h 15-2 h 30 in winter + 45 min fitting means you drive the last 20 min after sunset (about 16:45) on snowy roads, and Hirafu is a detour.
issues.evidence: https://rhythmjapan.com/winter-rentals-services (day-before pick-up from 13:00, return by 10:00 the day after); https://niseko-northern.com/facilities/ (hotel has its own ski/wear rental, walk-in, guests first)
issues.fix: Drive straight to the hotel (arrive about 15:45 in daylight) and rent at the hotel's own rental shop, or keep Rhythm but call for its free pick-up shuttle at Annupuri next morning. If you keep Rhythm: return by 10:00 on Jan 30, not 10:30.

issues.item: Niseko Northern Resort: laundry and room type
issues.problem: The hotel does have a coin laundry (1F) and a ski rental shop, and the 'deluxe twin' is a Hollywood twin (two 110 cm beds side by side).
issues.fix: Do laundry night 3 in the hotel (no Kutchan stop needed on Jan 28). If you want separate beds, ask for the standard twin when you book.

issues.problem: From Nov 1, 2026 the Niseko town tax changes from a fixed amount to a percentage of the room price, plus the Hokkaido tax; it is paid at the hotel and is not in the Jalan price.
issues.fix: Add about ¥1,000 per person per night (estimate) to the hotel budget, and check the exact rate when you book.
